final: WITH g AS (SELECT observstation AS st, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL HAVING COUNT(cnt) > 0), s AS (SELECT g.st, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avgshare FROM s WHERE share IS NOT NULL HAVING COUNT(share) > 0), r AS (SELECT s.st, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avgshare AS diff FROM s JOIN a ON a.avgshare IS NOT NULL) SELECT st AS observstation, cnt, share, diff FROM r ORDER BY (diff IS NULL), diff DESC LIMIT 10
